g.title: SHIELD_I2C
g.text: CNC Shield v3 — A4/A5 + 5V/GND pins (= R4 Wire bus, 5 V logic)
A4/A5 are the R4's primary I2C ('Wire'), 5 V logic, no on-board pull-ups: the PCA9685's 10 kΩ pull-ups to VCC=5 V do the job. NOT the R4's Qwiic socket (that is Wire1, 3.3 V).

g.title: PCA_LOGIC
g.text: PCA9685 logic header (6 pins, either end)
Adafruit-pattern silkscreen: GND OE SCL SDA VCC V+. OE left open (internal pull-down = outputs on). V+ pin unused; V+ enters at the terminal. Address 0x40 (no jumpers).

g.title: XL4015
g.text: XL4015 5 A buck — trim OUT to 6.0 V
Screw terminals. Set 6.00 V on the meter with nothing on OUT, then wire the PCA9685. Heatsink on. 4 A continuous derated.

g.title: PCA_PWR
g.text: The big 2-pin terminal at the end of the board = servo rail, NOT logic VCC.

g.title: PCA_CH0
g.text: PCA9685 channel 0 (3-pin, at the board's channel 0 end)
Rows on the board: PWM (top, yellow), V+ (middle, red), GND (bottom, black). Channels 1–15 empty.

g.title: TILT
g.text: Plugs straight onto channel 0, brown toward the board edge (GND row). Limits 65–150° in turret.py.
